alexcrichton opened PR #15138 from alexcrichton:move-fuel-tests to bytecodealliance:main:

This test was created a very long time ago with an ambitious vision for *.wast-style format tests with custom syntax, but this vision has not panned out. Instead add some small helpers in the "wasmtime" namespace (like "gc" that already exists) and port all the tests over to normal *.wast tests.
